def.en: A word or phrase people type into a search engine, which web pages try to rank for.
def.hi: Woh word ya phrase jo log search engine mein type karte hain aur jiske liye pages rank karna chahte hain.
def.mr: लोक search engine मध्ये टाइप करतात तो शब्द किंवा वाक्यांश, ज्यासाठी वेबपेजेस rank होण्याचा प्रयत्न करतात.

def.en: Website visitors who arrive by clicking unpaid search engine results rather than paid ads.
def.hi: Website visitors jo paid ads ke bajaye search engine ke free (unpaid) results par click karke aate hain.
def.mr: Paid ads ऐवजी search engine च्या मोफत (unpaid) results वर क्लिक करून वेबसाइटवर येणारे visitors.

def.en: A hyperlink on another website pointing to your site, often treated by search engines as a vote of trust.
def.hi: Kisi dusri website par diya gaya hyperlink jo aapki site ki taraf point karta hai; search engines ise trust ka vote maante hain.
def.mr: दुसऱ्या वेबसाइटवरील तुमच्या साइटकडे निर्देश करणारी hyperlink, जिला search engines विश्वासाचे मत मानतात.

def.en: The page a search engine displays after a query, listing organic results, ads and other features.
def.hi: Query karne ke baad search engine jo page dikhata hai, jisme organic results, ads aur dusre features hote hain.
def.mr: Query केल्यानंतर search engine दाखवतो ते पान, ज्यात organic results, ads आणि इतर features असतात.

def.en: The process where a search engine stores and organizes discovered pages so they become eligible to appear in results.
def.hi: Woh process jisme search engine mile hue pages ko apne database mein store aur organize karta hai taaki woh results mein dikh sakein.
def.mr: Search engine सापडलेली पाने आपल्या database मध्ये साठवून व्यवस्थित ठेवतो, जेणेकरून ती results मध्ये दिसू शकतील, ती प्रक्रिया.

def.en: A short HTML summary of a page that often appears beneath its clickable headline in search results.
def.hi: Page ka chhota HTML summary jo aksar search results mein clickable headline ke neeche dikhta hai.
def.mr: पेजचा छोटा HTML सारांश, जो search results मध्ये clickable headline च्या खाली अनेकदा दिसतो.

def.en: HTML element in a page's head that sets the clickable headline in search results and the browser tab name.
def.hi: Page ke head section ka HTML element jo search results ki clickable headline aur browser tab ka naam set karta hai.
def.mr: पेजच्या head मधील HTML element, जो search results मधील clickable headline आणि browser tab चे नाव ठरवतो.

def.en: Free listing that shows a local business's address, hours, reviews and map pin directly in search and map results.
def.hi: Free listing jo local dukaan ya company ka address, timing, reviews aur map pin seedha search aur map results mein dikhati hai.
def.mr: स्थानिक व्यवसायाचा पत्ता, वेळा, reviews आणि map pin थेट search आणि map results मध्ये दाखवणारी मोफत listing.

def.en: The visible, clickable words of a hyperlink, which help search engines understand what the linked page is about.
def.hi: Hyperlink ke visible, clickable words jo search engines ko samjhate hain ki linked page kis baare mein hai.
def.mr: Hyperlink मधील दिसणारे, clickable शब्द, जे linked पेज कशाबद्दल आहे हे search engines ना समजावतात.

def.en: A written description added to an image so screen readers and search engines can understand what it shows.
def.hi: Image ke saath jodi gayi likhit description taaki screen readers aur search engines samajh sakein ki usme kya hai.
def.mr: Image मध्ये काय आहे हे screen readers आणि search engines ना समजावे म्हणून जोडलेले लिखित वर्णन.

def.en: The underlying goal behind a query, such as learning something, finding a site, comparing options or buying.
def.hi: Query ke peeche ka asli maksad, jaise kuch seekhna, koi site dhoondhna, options compare karna ya kharidna.
def.mr: Query मागचा खरा उद्देश, जसे काही शिकणे, एखादी साइट शोधणे, पर्यायांची तुलना करणे किंवा खरेदी करणे.

def.en: A longer, highly specific search phrase with low volume but usually clearer intent and better conversion chances.
def.hi: Lamba aur bahut specific search phrase jiska volume kam hota hai par intent clear aur conversion chance zyada hota hai.
def.mr: कमी volume पण स्पष्ट intent आणि जास्त conversion शक्यता असलेला लांब, अतिशय specific search वाक्यांश.

def.en: A highlighted answer box shown above regular organic results, with text extracted directly from a webpage.
def.hi: Normal organic results ke upar dikhne wala highlighted answer box, jisme kisi webpage se seedha text liya jata hai.
def.mr: नेहमीच्या organic results च्या वर दिसणारा highlighted उत्तर box, ज्यातील मजकूर थेट एखाद्या webpage मधून घेतलेला असतो.

def.en: A file listing a website's important URLs so search engine crawlers can discover and crawl them efficiently.
def.hi: Ek file jisme website ke important URLs ki list hoti hai taaki search engine crawlers unhe aasani se dhoondh aur crawl kar sakein.
def.mr: वेबसाइटच्या महत्त्वाच्या URLs ची यादी असलेली file, जेणेकरून search engine crawlers त्यांना सहज शोधू आणि crawl करू शकतील.

def.en: A plain text file at a site's root telling crawlers which sections they may or may not access.
def.hi: Site ke root par rakhi plain text file jo crawlers ko batati hai ki kaunse sections access kar sakte hain aur kaunse nahi.
def.mr: साइटच्या root वर ठेवलेली साधी text file, जी crawlers ना कोणते भाग access करता येतील आणि कोणते नाही हे सांगते.

def.en: Structured data code added to pages so search engines can show rich results like star ratings, prices or FAQs.
def.hi: Pages mein joda gaya structured data code taaki search engines star ratings, price ya FAQs jaise rich results dikha sakein.
def.mr: पेजेसमध्ये जोडलेला structured data code, ज्यामुळे search engines star ratings, किंमत किंवा FAQs सारखे rich results दाखवू शकतात.

def.en: An HTML hint telling search engines which URL is the preferred master version when several pages have duplicate content.
def.hi: HTML hint jo search engines ko batata hai ki duplicate content wale kai pages mein se kaunsa URL main (preferred) version hai.
def.mr: अनेक पेजेसवर duplicate content असताना कोणती URL मुख्य (preferred) आवृत्ती आहे हे search engines ना सांगणारा HTML hint.

def.en: Google's set of page experience metrics measuring loading speed, responsiveness to input and visual stability.
def.hi: Google ke page experience metrics ka set jo loading speed, input par response aur visual stability ko measure karta hai.
def.mr: Loading speed, input ला प्रतिसाद आणि visual stability मोजणारा Google चा page experience metrics चा संच.

def.en: Keeping a business's name, address and phone number exactly identical across all online directories and listings.
def.hi: Business ka naam, address aur phone number sabhi online directories aur listings mein bilkul ek jaisa rakhna.
def.mr: व्यवसायाचे नाव, पत्ता आणि फोन नंबर सर्व online directories आणि listings मध्ये अगदी एकसारखे ठेवणे.

def.en: The number of pages a search engine bot is willing and able to fetch from a site within a given time.
def.hi: Kisi site se ek tay samay mein search engine bot jitne pages fetch karne ko taiyaar aur saksham hai, woh sankhya.
def.mr: ठराविक वेळेत search engine bot एखाद्या साइटवरून जितकी पाने fetch करण्यास तयार आणि सक्षम असतो, ती संख्या.

def.en: When several pages on the same site target one query and end up competing against each other in rankings.
def.hi: Jab ek hi site ke kai pages ek hi query ko target karte hain aur rankings mein aapas mein compete karne lagte hain.
def.mr: एकाच साइटवरील अनेक पाने एकाच query ला target करतात आणि rankings मध्ये एकमेकांशीच स्पर्धा करतात, ती स्थिती.

def.en: An HTML attribute telling search engines which language or regional version of a page to show each user.
def.hi: HTML attribute jo search engines ko batata hai ki har user ko page ka kaunsa language ya regional version dikhana hai.
def.mr: प्रत्येक user ला पेजची कोणती भाषा किंवा प्रादेशिक आवृत्ती दाखवायची हे search engines ना सांगणारा HTML attribute.

def.en: Google's quality rater framework judging content on the creator's experience, expertise, authoritativeness and trustworthiness.
def.hi: Google ke quality raters ka framework jo content ko creator ke experience, expertise, authoritativeness aur trustworthiness par judge karta hai.
def.mr: Creator चा experience, expertise, authoritativeness आणि trustworthiness यावर content तपासणारी Google च्या quality raters ची चौकट.

def.en: Studying raw server access records to see exactly which URLs search engine bots requested and how often.
def.hi: Raw server access records ko study karna taaki pata chale ki search engine bots ne kaunse URLs kitni baar request kiye.
def.mr: Search engine bots नी कोणत्या URLs किती वेळा मागितल्या हे अचूक पाहण्यासाठी raw server access records चा अभ्यास करणे.

def.en: Search Console feature for asking Google to ignore specific spammy or unnatural links pointing to your site.
def.hi: Search Console ka feature jisse aap Google ko kehte hain ki aapki site ki taraf aane wale spammy ya unnatural links ko ignore kare.
def.mr: तुमच्या साइटकडे येणाऱ्या spammy किंवा अनैसर्गिक links दुर्लक्षित करण्यास Google ला सांगणारे Search Console मधील feature.

def.en: A single instance of an ad being displayed on someone's screen, whether or not it gets clicked.
def.hi: Ad ka ek baar kisi ki screen par display hona, chahe us par click ho ya na ho.
def.mr: जाहिरात एखाद्याच्या screen वर एकदा दाखवली जाणे, त्यावर click झाला असो वा नसो.

def.en: The amount an advertiser pays each time someone clicks on their ad.
def.hi: Woh amount jo advertiser har baar deta hai jab koi uske ad par click karta hai.
def.mr: कोणी जाहिरातीवर प्रत्येक वेळी click केल्यावर advertiser देतो ती रक्कम.

def.en: Percentage of people who clicked an ad after seeing it, calculated as clicks divided by impressions.
def.hi: Ad dekhne walon mein se kitne percent logon ne us par click kiya; clicks ko impressions se divide karke nikalta hai.
def.mr: जाहिरात पाहणाऱ्यांपैकी किती टक्के लोकांनी click केले; clicks ला impressions ने भागून काढले जाते.

def.en: The price an advertiser pays for one thousand displays of an ad.
def.hi: Ad ke har ek hazaar (1,000) displays ke liye advertiser jo price deta hai.
def.mr: जाहिरातीच्या प्रत्येक एक हजार (1,000) displays साठी advertiser देतो ती किंमत.

def.en: Average ad spend needed to win one desired action, such as a purchase, sign-up or lead.
def.hi: Ek desired action, jaise purchase, sign-up ya lead, paane ke liye average kitna ad spend laga.
def.mr: एक अपेक्षित action (खरेदी, sign-up किंवा lead) मिळवण्यासाठी सरासरी लागलेला ad खर्च.

def.en: Showing ads to people who previously visited your website or app but left without converting.
def.hi: Un logon ko ads dikhana jo pehle aapki website ya app par aaye the par bina convert kiye chale gaye.
def.mr: आधी तुमच्या वेबसाइट किंवा app ला भेट देऊन convert न होता निघून गेलेल्या लोकांना पुन्हा जाहिराती दाखवणे.

def.en: The average number of times one person has seen the same ad during a given period.
def.hi: Ek tay samay mein ek hi vyakti ne same ad average kitni baar dekha.
def.mr: ठराविक कालावधीत एका व्यक्तीने तीच जाहिरात सरासरी किती वेळा पाहिली, ती संख्या.

def.en: Revenue earned for every rupee spent on advertising, calculated as ad revenue divided by ad cost.
def.hi: Advertising par kharch kiye har ek rupaye par kitna revenue aaya; ad revenue ko ad cost se divide karke.
def.mr: जाहिरातीवर खर्च केलेल्या प्रत्येक रुपयामागे मिळालेले revenue; ad revenue ला ad खर्चाने भागून काढतात.

def.en: A search term you exclude so your ads don't show for irrelevant queries.
def.hi: Aisa search term jise aap exclude karte hain taaki irrelevant queries par aapke ads na dikhein.
def.mr: असंबंधित queries वर जाहिराती दिसू नयेत म्हणून तुम्ही वगळता (exclude) तो search term.

def.en: A new group of people the ad platform finds who share traits with an advertiser's existing customers.
def.hi: Logon ka naya group jise ad platform dhoondhta hai, jinki khoobiyan advertiser ke maujooda customers jaisi hoti hain.
def.mr: Advertiser च्या सध्याच्या ग्राहकांसारखी वैशिष्ट्ये असलेल्या नवीन लोकांचा गट, जो ad platform शोधतो.

def.en: Google Ads' 1-10 rating of a keyword based on expected CTR, ad relevance and landing page experience.
def.hi: Google Ads ki 1-10 rating jo keyword ko expected CTR, ad relevance aur landing page experience ke basis par milti hai.
def.mr: Expected CTR, ad relevance आणि landing page experience यावर आधारित keyword ला Google Ads देत असलेले 1-10 rating.

def.en: Value that decides whether and where an ad appears in a search auction, using bid, ad quality and context.
def.hi: Woh value jo tay karti hai ki search auction mein ad dikhega ya nahi aur kis position par; bid, ad quality aur context se banti hai.
def.mr: Search auction मध्ये जाहिरात दिसेल का आणि कोणत्या स्थानावर हे ठरवणारे मूल्य; bid, ad quality आणि context वरून ठरते.

def.en: Google campaign type that uses automation to run one campaign across Search, YouTube, Display, Gmail, Maps and Discover.
def.hi: Google ka campaign type jo automation se ek hi campaign ko Search, YouTube, Display, Gmail, Maps aur Discover par chalata hai.
def.mr: Automation वापरून एकच campaign Search, YouTube, Display, Gmail, Maps आणि Discover वर चालवणारा Google चा campaign प्रकार.

def.en: Declining results when an audience sees the same creative too often and stops responding to it.
def.hi: Jab audience ek hi creative ko baar-baar dekhkar respond karna band kar deti hai aur results girne lagte hain.
def.mr: प्रेक्षक तेच creative पुन्हा पुन्हा पाहून प्रतिसाद देणे थांबवतात आणि results घसरू लागतात, ती स्थिती.

def.en: Automated bid strategy that aims to get as many conversions as possible at an average cost per action you set.
def.hi: Automated bid strategy jo aapke set kiye average cost per action par zyada se zyada conversions laane ki koshish karti hai.
def.mr: तुम्ही ठरवलेल्या सरासरी cost per action वर जास्तीत जास्त conversions मिळवण्याचा प्रयत्न करणारी automated bid strategy.

def.en: Whether an ad actually had a chance to be seen, such as at least 50% of pixels on screen for one second.
def.hi: Kya ad ko sach mein dekhe jaane ka mauka mila, jaise kam se kam 50% pixels ek second tak screen par rahe.
def.mr: जाहिरात खरोखर दिसण्याची संधी मिळाली का, उदा. किमान 50% pixels एक सेकंद screen वर राहिले का, याचे मोजमाप.

def.en: Percentage of eligible ad auctions in which your ad was actually shown to searchers.
def.hi: Jin auctions ke liye aapka ad eligible tha, unme se kitne percent mein woh sach mein logon ko dikha.
def.mr: तुमची जाहिरात ज्या auctions साठी पात्र होती, त्यापैकी किती टक्क्यांमध्ये ती प्रत्यक्ष लोकांना दिसली.

def.en: Automated buying and selling of digital ad space using software, data and algorithms instead of manual negotiation.
def.hi: Software, data aur algorithms se digital ad space ki automated kharid-bikri, manual negotiation ke bina.
def.mr: Manual वाटाघाटीऐवजी software, data आणि algorithms वापरून digital ad जागेची automated खरेदी-विक्री.

def.en: Software advertisers use to buy ad inventory automatically across many exchanges from a single interface.
def.hi: Software jise advertisers ek hi interface se kai exchanges par ad inventory automatically kharidne ke liye use karte hain.
def.mr: एकाच interface मधून अनेक exchanges वर ad inventory आपोआप खरेदी करण्यासाठी advertisers वापरतात ते software.

def.en: Software publishers use to offer their ad inventory to many buyers at once and maximize its yield.
def.hi: Software jise publishers apni ad inventory ek saath kai buyers ko bechne aur revenue maximize karne ke liye use karte hain.
def.mr: आपली ad inventory एकाच वेळी अनेक खरेदीदारांना विकून उत्पन्न वाढवण्यासाठी publishers वापरतात ते software.

def.en: Auction process where each individual ad impression is bought and sold in milliseconds while a page loads.
def.hi: Auction process jisme har ek ad impression page load hote waqt milliseconds mein kharida-becha jata hai.
def.mr: पेज load होत असताना प्रत्येक ad impression काही milliseconds मध्ये खरेदी-विक्री होणारी auction प्रक्रिया.

def.en: A conversion credited to an ad the user saw but did not click before later converting.
def.hi: Aisa conversion jiska credit us ad ko milta hai jise user ne dekha tha par click nahi kiya, aur baad mein convert hua.
def.mr: User ने पाहिलेल्या पण click न केलेल्या जाहिरातीला, नंतर झालेल्या conversion चे श्रेय देणे.

def.en: Experiment comparing people exposed and not exposed to ads to measure changes in awareness, recall or consideration.
def.hi: Experiment jo ads dekhne wale aur na dekhne wale logon ko compare karke awareness, recall ya consideration mein badlav measure karta hai.
def.mr: जाहिराती पाहिलेल्या आणि न पाहिलेल्या लोकांची तुलना करून awareness, recall किंवा consideration मधील बदल मोजणारा प्रयोग.

def.en: Ad clicks or impressions generated by bots, fraud or accidental activity that should not be billed.
def.hi: Bots, fraud ya galti se hui activity se aaye ad clicks ya impressions jinka paisa nahi lagna chahiye.
def.mr: Bots, फसवणूक किंवा चुकून झालेल्या activity मुळे आलेले ad clicks किंवा impressions, ज्यांचे पैसे आकारले जाऊ नयेत.

def.en: Publisher technique letting multiple ad exchanges bid on inventory simultaneously before the ad server is called.
def.hi: Publisher technique jisme ad server ko call karne se pehle kai ad exchanges ek saath inventory par bid karte hain.
def.mr: Ad server ला call करण्यापूर्वी अनेक ad exchanges ना एकाच वेळी inventory वर bid करू देणारी publisher technique.

def.en: A word or phrase prefixed with the # symbol that groups related posts and makes them discoverable.
def.hi: # symbol ke saath likha word ya phrase jo related posts ko group karta hai aur unhe dhoondhne mein madad karta hai.
def.mr: # चिन्हाने सुरू होणारा शब्द किंवा वाक्यांश, जो संबंधित posts एकत्र करतो आणि त्यांना शोधणे सोपे करतो.

def.en: A user who subscribes to an account so its new posts appear in their feed.
def.hi: Woh user jo kisi account ko subscribe karta hai taaki uske naye posts uski feed mein dikhein.
def.mr: एखाद्या account ला subscribe करणारा user, ज्यामुळे त्या account च्या नवीन posts त्याच्या feed मध्ये दिसतात.

def.en: Temporary photo or video posts that disappear after 24 hours, shown at the top of apps like Instagram.
def.hi: Temporary photo ya video posts jo 24 ghante baad gayab ho jaate hain, Instagram jaise apps mein upar dikhte hain.
def.mr: 24 तासांनंतर नाहीसे होणारे तात्पुरते photo किंवा video posts, जे Instagram सारख्या apps मध्ये वर दिसतात.

def.en: A creator whose audience trusts them enough that their recommendations can sway followers' buying decisions.
def.hi: Aisa creator jiski audience us par itna bharosa karti hai ki uski recommendations followers ke kharidne ke faisle badal sakti hain.
def.mr: असा creator ज्याच्यावर प्रेक्षक इतका विश्वास ठेवतात की त्याच्या शिफारसी followers च्या खरेदी निर्णयांवर प्रभाव टाकतात.

def.en: When a piece of content spreads extremely fast because huge numbers of people share it.
def.hi: Jab koi content bahut tezi se phailta hai kyunki bahut saare log use share karte hain.
def.mr: खूप लोक share करत असल्यामुळे एखादा content अतिशय वेगाने पसरतो, ती स्थिती.

def.en: Share of likes, comments, shares and saves a post gets relative to its reach or follower count.
def.hi: Post ko mile likes, comments, shares aur saves ka hissa, uski reach ya followers ki sankhya ke mukable.
def.mr: Post च्या reach किंवा followers संख्येच्या तुलनेत मिळालेल्या likes, comments, shares आणि saves चे प्रमाण.

def.en: The number of unique people who saw a piece of content at least once.
def.hi: Kitne alag-alag (unique) logon ne koi content kam se kam ek baar dekha, woh sankhya.
def.mr: एखादा content किमान एकदा पाहणाऱ्या वेगवेगळ्या (unique) लोकांची संख्या.

def.en: A single post containing multiple images or videos that viewers swipe through.
def.hi: Ek hi post jisme kai images ya videos hote hain jinhe viewers swipe karke dekhte hain.
def.mr: अनेक images किंवा videos असलेली एकच post, जी पाहणारे swipe करून पाहतात.

def.en: Photos, videos, reviews or posts about a brand created by its customers rather than by the brand itself.
def.hi: Brand ke baare mein photos, videos, reviews ya posts jo brand ne nahi, balki uske customers ne banaye hain.
def.mr: ब्रँडने नव्हे तर त्याच्या ग्राहकांनी ब्रँडबद्दल तयार केलेले photos, videos, reviews किंवा posts.

def.en: The system that decides which posts each user sees and in what order, based on predicted interest.
def.hi: Woh system jo tay karta hai ki har user ko kaunse posts aur kis order mein dikhenge, uski sambhavit ruchi ke hisaab se.
def.mr: प्रत्येक user ला कोणत्या posts कोणत्या क्रमाने दिसतील हे त्याच्या संभाव्य आवडीनुसार ठरवणारी प्रणाली.

def.en: Actively replying to comments and messages and moderating discussions to build relationships with an audience.
def.hi: Comments aur messages ka jawab dena aur discussions ko moderate karna taaki audience ke saath rishta bane.
def.mr: प्रेक्षकांशी नाते जोडण्यासाठी comments आणि messages ना उत्तर देणे व चर्चांचे moderation करणे.

def.en: Monitoring online conversations about a brand, competitors or topics to spot trends, sentiment and issues.
def.hi: Brand, competitors ya topics ke baare mein online baatcheet ko monitor karna taaki trends, sentiment aur problems pakde ja sakein.
def.mr: Trends, sentiment आणि समस्या ओळखण्यासाठी ब्रँड, स्पर्धक किंवा विषयांबद्दलच्या online चर्चांवर लक्ष ठेवणे.

def.en: A creator with a small but highly engaged audience, usually around 1,000 to 10,000 followers.
def.hi: Chhoti par bahut engaged audience wala creator, aam taur par lagbhag 1,000 se 10,000 followers.
def.mr: लहान पण अतिशय engaged प्रेक्षक असलेला creator, साधारणपणे 1,000 ते 10,000 followers.

def.en: The psychological tendency to trust something because many other people use, like or recommend it.
def.hi: Woh manovaigyanik aadat jisme hum kisi cheez par bharosa karte hain kyunki bahut log use use, like ya recommend karte hain.
def.mr: अनेक लोक एखादी गोष्ट वापरतात, आवडतात किंवा शिफारस करतात म्हणून तिच्यावर विश्वास ठेवण्याची मानसिक प्रवृत्ती.

def.en: Selling products directly inside social media apps so users can buy without leaving the platform.
def.hi: Social media apps ke andar hi products bechna taaki users platform chhode bina kharid sakein.
def.mr: Social media apps मध्येच products विकणे, ज्यामुळे users platform न सोडता खरेदी करू शकतात.

def.en: Numbers like likes or follower counts that look impressive but don't reflect real business results.
def.hi: Likes ya followers jaise numbers jo dekhne mein impressive lagte hain par asli business results nahi dikhate.
def.mr: Likes किंवा followers सारखे आकडे जे प्रभावी दिसतात पण खरे business results दाखवत नाहीत.

def.en: A brand's portion of total online conversation or visibility in its category compared with competitors.
def.hi: Apni category mein competitors ke mukable online baatcheet ya visibility mein brand ka hissa.
def.mr: आपल्या category मध्ये स्पर्धकांच्या तुलनेत online चर्चा किंवा visibility मधील ब्रँडचा वाटा.

def.en: Content sharing through private channels like WhatsApp or direct messages that analytics tools can't attribute to a source.
def.hi: WhatsApp ya direct messages jaise private channels se hone wali sharing jise analytics tools kisi source se jod nahi paate.
def.mr: WhatsApp किंवा direct messages सारख्या खाजगी माध्यमांतून होणारे sharing, ज्याचा source analytics tools ओळखू शकत नाहीत.

def.en: A group of users who agree to like and comment on each other's posts to game the platform's ranking system.
def.hi: Users ka group jo platform ke ranking system ko chakma dene ke liye ek-dusre ke posts par like aur comment karta hai.
def.mr: Platform च्या ranking system ला फसवण्यासाठी एकमेकांच्या posts वर like आणि comment करण्याचे ठरवणारा users चा गट.

def.en: When a platform quietly limits the visibility of a user's content without notifying them.
def.hi: Jab platform bina bataye chupchaap kisi user ke content ki visibility kam kar deta hai.
def.mr: Platform user ला न कळवता त्याच्या content ची visibility गुपचूप कमी करतो, ती स्थिती.

def.en: Arrangement where a brand runs paid ads through a creator's own account handle with their permission.
def.hi: Aisa arrangement jisme brand creator ki permission se uske account handle ke through paid ads chalata hai.
def.mr: Creator च्या परवानगीने त्याच्या account handle मधून ब्रँड paid ads चालवतो, अशी व्यवस्था.

def.en: Estimated monetary worth of unpaid exposure a brand gains from shares, mentions and creator posts.
def.hi: Shares, mentions aur creator posts se brand ko mili unpaid exposure ki anumanit paisa value.
def.mr: Shares, mentions आणि creator posts मधून ब्रँडला मिळालेल्या unpaid प्रसिद्धीचे अंदाजे आर्थिक मूल्य.

def.en: A map of connections between users that platforms use to recommend people and content.
def.hi: Users ke beech connections ka naksha jise platforms log aur content recommend karne ke liye use karte hain.
def.mr: Users मधील connections चा नकाशा, ज्याचा वापर platforms लोक आणि content सुचवण्यासाठी करतात.

def.en: A one-sided emotional bond a follower feels toward a creator who doesn't know them personally.
def.hi: Ektarfa emotional rishta jo follower ek aise creator se mehsoos karta hai jo use personally nahi jaanta.
def.mr: Follower ला वैयक्तिक ओळख नसलेल्या creator बद्दल वाटणारे एकतर्फी भावनिक नाते.

def.en: Faking grassroots public support using fake accounts or paid posters so a campaign looks organic.
def.hi: Fake accounts ya paid posters se nakli janta-samarthan dikhana taaki campaign organic lage.
def.mr: बनावट accounts किंवा पैसे देऊन पोस्ट करणारे वापरून खोटा लोकपाठिंबा दाखवणे, जेणेकरून campaign नैसर्गिक वाटेल.

def.en: Each time a web page is loaded or reloaded in a visitor's browser and recorded by analytics.
def.hi: Har baar jab visitor ke browser mein koi web page load ya reload hota hai aur analytics use record karta hai.
def.mr: Visitor च्या browser मध्ये एखादे web page प्रत्येक वेळी load किंवा reload होऊन analytics मध्ये नोंदवले जाणे.

def.en: Where a website visitor came from, such as a search engine, social media, email or typing the address directly.
def.hi: Website visitor kahan se aaya, jaise search engine, social media, email ya seedha address type karke.
def.mr: वेबसाइट visitor कुठून आला, उदा. search engine, social media, email किंवा थेट address टाइप करून.

def.en: Percentage of visits in which the person left without meaningful interaction, such as briefly viewing just one page.
def.hi: Un visits ka percentage jisme visitor bina kisi meaningful interaction ke chala gaya, jaise sirf ek page thodi der dekhkar.
def.mr: Visitor कोणताही अर्थपूर्ण interaction न करता निघून गेला (उदा. फक्त एक पान थोडा वेळ पाहून) अशा भेटींची टक्केवारी.

def.en: Percentage of visitors or sessions that complete a desired goal, such as a purchase or sign-up.
def.hi: Visitors ya sessions ka woh percentage jo koi desired goal, jaise purchase ya sign-up, poora karta hai.
def.mr: खरेदी किंवा sign-up सारखे अपेक्षित ध्येय पूर्ण करणाऱ्या visitors किंवा sessions ची टक्केवारी.

def.en: A group of interactions by one user on a site within a time frame, ending after a period of inactivity.
def.hi: Ek user ke site par ek time frame mein kiye gaye interactions ka group, jo kuch der inactive rehne par khatam hota hai.
def.mr: एका user ने ठराविक कालावधीत साइटवर केलेल्या interactions चा गट, जो काही वेळ निष्क्रिय राहिल्यावर संपतो.

def.en: A visual screen that summarizes key metrics in charts and tables for quick monitoring.
def.hi: Ek visual screen jo important metrics ko charts aur tables mein summarize karti hai taaki jaldi monitor ho sake.
def.mr: महत्त्वाचे metrics charts आणि tables मध्ये सारांशित करून पटकन देखरेख करू देणारी visual screen.

def.en: A measurable value chosen to track progress toward an important business objective.
def.hi: Ek measurable value jo kisi important business objective ki taraf progress track karne ke liye chuni jaati hai.
def.mr: महत्त्वाच्या business उद्दिष्टाकडील प्रगती मोजण्यासाठी निवडलेले मोजता येणारे मूल्य.

def.en: Splitting traffic between two versions of a page or element to see which performs better.
def.hi: Traffic ko ek page ya element ke do versions mein baantna taaki pata chale kaunsa behtar perform karta hai.
def.mr: कोणती आवृत्ती चांगली चालते हे पाहण्यासाठी पेज किंवा element च्या दोन आवृत्त्यांमध्ये traffic विभागणे.

def.en: Tags added to the end of a URL to identify the source, medium and campaign that sent a visitor.
def.hi: URL ke end mein jode gaye tags jo batate hain ki visitor ko kis source, medium aur campaign ne bheja.
def.mr: Visitor ला कोणत्या source, medium आणि campaign ने पाठवले हे ओळखण्यासाठी URL च्या शेवटी जोडलेले tags.

def.en: In GA4, any tracked user interaction such as a page load, click, scroll or purchase, the basic unit of data.
def.hi: GA4 mein koi bhi track kiya gaya user interaction, jaise page load, click, scroll ya purchase; data ki basic unit.
def.mr: GA4 मध्ये track केलेला कोणताही user interaction, उदा. page load, click, scroll किंवा खरेदी; data चे मूलभूत एकक.

def.en: A color-coded visual showing where visitors click, move or scroll most on a page.
def.hi: Color-coded visual jo dikhata hai ki visitors page par sabse zyada kahan click, move ya scroll karte hain.
def.mr: Visitors पेजवर सर्वाधिक कुठे click, move किंवा scroll करतात हे रंगांनी दाखवणारे visual.

def.en: Free Google tool for adding and managing tracking codes on a site without editing its source code each time.
def.hi: Google ka free tool jisse website par tracking codes add aur manage kiye jaate hain, har baar source code edit kiye bina.
def.mr: प्रत्येक वेळी source code न बदलता वेबसाइटवर tracking codes जोडण्यासाठी व सांभाळण्यासाठी Google चे मोफत tool.

def.en: A rule set deciding how credit for a conversion is shared among the marketing touchpoints that led to it.
def.hi: Rules ka set jo tay karta hai ki conversion ka credit usse pehle ke marketing touchpoints mein kaise baanta jaye.
def.mr: Conversion पर्यंत नेणाऱ्या marketing touchpoints मध्ये त्याचे श्रेय कसे वाटायचे हे ठरवणारे नियम.

def.en: Giving 100% of the credit for a conversion to the final channel or ad clicked before it.
def.hi: Conversion ka 100% credit usse theek pehle click kiye gaye aakhri channel ya ad ko dena.
def.mr: Conversion चे 100% श्रेय त्याच्या आधी click केलेल्या शेवटच्या channel किंवा ad ला देणे.

def.en: Studying groups of users who share a start date or trait to compare how their behavior changes over time.
def.hi: Ek jaisi start date ya khoobi wale users ke groups ko study karna taaki samay ke saath unka behavior compare ho sake.
def.mr: एकच सुरुवात तारीख किंवा वैशिष्ट्य असलेल्या users च्या गटांचा अभ्यास करून कालांतराने त्यांच्या वर्तनाची तुलना करणे.

def.en: In GA4, a visit lasting over 10 seconds, including a key event, or having two or more page views.
def.hi: GA4 mein aisi visit jo 10 second se lambi ho, jisme key event ho, ya jisme do ya zyada page views hon.
def.mr: GA4 मध्ये 10 सेकंदांपेक्षा जास्त चाललेली, key event असलेली किंवा दोन किंवा अधिक page views असलेली भेट.

def.en: Confidence that a test result reflects a real difference rather than random chance, often judged by a p-value.
def.hi: Yeh bharosa ki test ka result asli fark dikhata hai, random chance nahi; aksar p-value se judge hota hai.
def.mr: चाचणीचा निकाल योगायोग नसून खरा फरक दाखवतो याचा विश्वास; अनेकदा p-value वरून ठरवला जातो.

def.en: Experiment testing several page elements and their combinations at once to find the best-performing mix.
def.hi: Experiment jo ek saath kai page elements aur unke combinations test karta hai taaki best-performing mix mile.
def.mr: सर्वोत्तम mix शोधण्यासाठी एकाच वेळी पेजवरील अनेक elements आणि त्यांचे combinations तपासणारा प्रयोग.

def.en: A JavaScript object on a page holding structured information for tag managers to read and send to tools.
def.hi: Page par ek JavaScript object jisme structured information hoti hai jise tag managers padhkar tools ko bhejte hain.
def.mr: पेजवरील JavaScript object ज्यात structured माहिती असते, जी tag managers वाचून tools कडे पाठवतात.

def.en: Sending tracking data first to your own cloud server, which then forwards it to analytics and ad platforms.
def.hi: Tracking data pehle apne cloud server par bhejna, jo phir use analytics aur ad platforms ko forward karta hai.
def.mr: Tracking data आधी स्वतःच्या cloud server वर पाठवणे, जो ते पुढे analytics आणि ad platforms कडे पाठवतो.

def.en: Google feature that adjusts how tags behave based on users' cookie choices and models the data lost.
def.hi: Google feature jo users ki cookie choices ke hisaab se tags ka behavior badalta hai aur khoye data ko model karta hai.
def.mr: Users च्या cookie निवडीनुसार tags चे वर्तन बदलणारे आणि गमावलेला data model करणारे Google चे feature.

def.en: Statistical regression on aggregate historical data to estimate each channel's contribution to sales.
def.hi: Aggregate historical data par statistical regression jisse har channel ka sales mein yogdaan estimate kiya jata hai.
def.mr: प्रत्येक channel चा sales मधील वाटा अंदाजण्यासाठी एकत्रित ऐतिहासिक data वर केलेले statistical regression.

def.en: Experiment comparing an exposed group with a holdout group to measure conversions caused only by marketing.
def.hi: Experiment jo exposed group ko holdout group se compare karke sirf marketing ki wajah se hue conversions measure karta hai.
def.mr: फक्त marketing मुळे झालेले conversions मोजण्यासाठी exposed गट आणि holdout गटाची तुलना करणारा प्रयोग.

def.en: Warning in an experiment when the traffic split between variants differs significantly from the planned allocation.
def.hi: Experiment ki warning jab variants ke beech traffic ka split planned allocation se kaafi alag hota hai.
def.mr: Variants मधील traffic विभागणी नियोजित वाटपापेक्षा लक्षणीय वेगळी असल्यास प्रयोगात मिळणारा इशारा.

def.en: When a trend seen within several data groups reverses or disappears once the groups are combined.
def.hi: Jab kai data groups mein dikhne wala trend groups ko jodne par ulat jata hai ya gayab ho jata hai.
def.mr: अनेक data गटांमध्ये दिसणारा trend गट एकत्र केल्यावर उलटतो किंवा नाहीसा होतो, ती स्थिती.

def.en: A regularly updated website section of articles, often written in an informal or conversational style.
def.hi: Website ka regularly update hone wala section jisme articles hote hain, aksar informal ya baatcheet wale style mein.
def.mr: वेबसाइटचा नियमित update होणारा लेखांचा विभाग, अनेकदा अनौपचारिक किंवा संवादात्मक शैलीत लिहिलेला.

def.en: A prompt telling the reader what to do next, such as 'Buy Now' or 'Sign Up'.
def.hi: Aisa prompt jo reader ko batata hai ki aage kya karna hai, jaise 'Buy Now' ya 'Sign Up'.
def.mr: वाचकाने पुढे काय करावे हे सांगणारा संदेश, उदा. 'Buy Now' किंवा 'Sign Up'.

def.en: A regular email sent to subscribers with updates, tips or curated content.
def.hi: Subscribers ko bheja jaane wala regular email jisme updates, tips ya curated content hota hai.
def.mr: Subscribers ना नियमितपणे पाठवला जाणारा email, ज्यात updates, tips किंवा निवडक content असतो.

def.en: A standalone web page built for one campaign goal, where visitors arrive after clicking an ad or link.
def.hi: Ek campaign goal ke liye bana alag web page, jahan visitors ad ya link par click karke pahunchte hain.
def.mr: एका campaign उद्दिष्टासाठी बनवलेले स्वतंत्र web page, जिथे visitors ad किंवा link वर click करून पोहोचतात.

def.en: Software that stores customer contacts, interactions and deals to manage sales and relationships.
def.hi: Software jo customer contacts, interactions aur deals store karta hai taaki sales aur rishte manage ho sakein.
def.mr: Sales आणि ग्राहकांशी नाते सांभाळण्यासाठी customer contacts, interactions आणि deals साठवणारे software.

def.en: The consistent personality and tone a company uses across all its written and spoken communication.
def.hi: Woh consistent personality aur tone jo company apne saare likhit aur bole gaye communication mein use karti hai.
def.mr: कंपनी आपल्या सर्व लिखित आणि बोलीतील संवादात वापरते ते सातत्यपूर्ण व्यक्तिमत्त्व आणि tone.

def.en: A free resource like an e-book or checklist offered in exchange for someone's contact details.
def.hi: Free resource jaise e-book ya checklist jo kisi ke contact details ke badle mein diya jata hai.
def.mr: एखाद्याच्या contact details च्या बदल्यात दिले जाणारे e-book किंवा checklist सारखे मोफत resource.

def.en: Percentage of delivered emails in a campaign that recipients actually opened.
def.hi: Campaign ke deliver hue emails mein se kitne percent recipients ne sach mein khole.
def.mr: Campaign मधील deliver झालेल्या emails पैकी किती टक्के recipients नी प्रत्यक्ष उघडले.

def.en: A model of the stages a customer moves through, from first awareness to purchase and beyond.
def.hi: Un stages ka model jinse customer guzarta hai, pehli awareness se lekar purchase aur uske baad tak.
def.mr: ग्राहक पहिल्या awareness पासून खरेदी आणि त्यानंतरपर्यंत ज्या टप्प्यांतून जातो त्यांचे model.

def.en: A semi-fictional profile of an ideal customer, built from research on their needs, goals and behavior.
def.hi: Ideal customer ki semi-fictional profile, jo unki needs, goals aur behavior par research se banti hai.
def.mr: आदर्श ग्राहकाची अर्ध-काल्पनिक profile, जी त्याच्या गरजा, ध्येये आणि वर्तनावरील संशोधनातून बनते.

def.en: The one distinctive benefit that makes a product stand out from its competitors.
def.hi: Woh ek khaas benefit jo product ko uske competitors se alag aur behtar dikhata hai.
def.mr: Product ला स्पर्धकांपेक्षा वेगळे ठरवणारा एक खास फायदा.

def.en: A series of automated emails sent on a schedule or triggered by user actions.
def.hi: Automated emails ki series jo schedule par ya user ke actions se trigger hokar bheji jaati hai.
def.mr: ठरलेल्या वेळापत्रकानुसार किंवा user च्या actions मुळे trigger होऊन पाठवल्या जाणाऱ्या automated emails ची मालिका.

def.en: Copywriting framework guiding readers through attention, interest, desire and then action.
def.hi: Copywriting framework jo reader ko attention, interest, desire aur phir action tak le jata hai.
def.mr: वाचकाला attention, interest, desire आणि मग action पर्यंत नेणारी copywriting चौकट.

def.en: Material that stays relevant and useful for a long time instead of quickly becoming outdated.
def.hi: Aisa material jo jaldi purana hone ke bajaye lambe samay tak relevant aur useful rehta hai.
def.mr: लवकर जुने होण्याऐवजी दीर्घकाळ उपयुक्त आणि relevant राहणारे साहित्य.

def.en: Assigning points to prospects based on behavior and profile to judge how ready they are for sales.
def.hi: Prospects ko unke behavior aur profile ke hisaab se points dena taaki pata chale woh sales ke liye kitne ready hain.
def.mr: Prospects sales साठी किती तयार आहेत हे ठरवण्यासाठी त्यांच्या वर्तन आणि profile नुसार गुण देणे.

def.en: A comprehensive page covering a broad topic that links out to detailed related articles on subtopics.
def.hi: Broad topic ko cover karne wala comprehensive page jo subtopics ke detailed related articles se link karta hai.
def.mr: व्यापक विषय सविस्तर मांडणारे पान, जे उपविषयांवरील सविस्तर संबंधित लेखांना link करते.

def.en: Sign-up process where a subscriber must confirm their email address by clicking a verification link.
def.hi: Sign-up process jisme subscriber ko verification link par click karke apna email address confirm karna padta hai.
def.mr: Subscriber ला verification link वर click करून आपला email address निश्चित करावा लागतो अशी sign-up प्रक्रिया.

def.en: A prospect whose engagement shows real interest but who isn't yet ready for a sales conversation.
def.hi: Aisa prospect jiska engagement asli interest dikhata hai par jo abhi sales baatcheet ke liye ready nahi hai.
def.mr: ज्याचा engagement खरी आवड दाखवतो पण जो अजून sales संवादासाठी तयार नाही असा prospect.

def.en: The ability of sent emails to land in recipients' inboxes rather than spam folders or being blocked.
def.hi: Bheje gaye emails ki inbox tak pahunchne ki kshamata, spam folder mein jaane ya block hone ke bajaye.
def.mr: पाठवलेले emails spam folder मध्ये न जाता किंवा block न होता inbox पर्यंत पोहोचण्याची क्षमता.

def.en: The gradual drop in traffic and rankings an older article suffers as it becomes outdated.
def.hi: Purane article ke outdated hone par uske traffic aur rankings mein dheere-dheere girawat.
def.mr: जुना लेख कालबाह्य होत गेल्याने त्याच्या traffic आणि rankings मध्ये हळूहळू होणारी घसरण.

def.en: Copywriting formula that names a pain point, intensifies it, then presents the product as the fix.
def.hi: Copywriting formula jo pehle pain point batata hai, use aur gehra karta hai, phir product ko hal ke roop mein dikhata hai.
def.mr: आधी अडचण मांडणारा, ती अधिक तीव्र करणारा आणि मग product ला उपाय म्हणून सादर करणारा copywriting formula.

def.en: System that unifies customer data from all sources into single persistent profiles for marketing use.
def.hi: System jo sabhi sources ka customer data jodkar marketing ke liye har customer ki ek persistent profile banata hai.
def.mr: सर्व sources मधील customer data एकत्र करून marketing साठी प्रत्येक ग्राहकाची एकच कायमस्वरूपी profile बनवणारी प्रणाली.

def.en: Email authentication policy telling receiving servers how to handle messages that fail SPF or DKIM checks.
def.hi: Email authentication policy jo receiving servers ko batati hai ki SPF ya DKIM check fail hone wale messages ka kya karein.
def.mr: SPF किंवा DKIM तपासणीत अपयशी ठरणाऱ्या messages चे काय करायचे हे receiving servers ना सांगणारी email authentication policy.

def.en: Framework viewing customers as 'hiring' a product to make progress on a specific goal in their life.
def.hi: Framework jo maanta hai ki customer apni life ke kisi khaas goal mein aage badhne ke liye product ko 'hire' karta hai.
def.mr: ग्राहक आयुष्यातील विशिष्ट ध्येयाकडे प्रगती करण्यासाठी product ला 'hire' करतो, असे मानणारी चौकट.

def.en: The psychological tendency to prefer things simply because we have encountered them repeatedly.
def.hi: Woh manovaigyanik aadat jisme hum cheezon ko sirf isliye pasand karte hain kyunki humne unhe baar-baar dekha hai.
def.mr: एखादी गोष्ट वारंवार समोर आल्यामुळेच ती आवडू लागण्याची मानसिक प्रवृत्ती.

def.en: Payment option where the buyer pays in cash or UPI only when the order reaches their doorstep.
def.hi: Payment option jisme buyer order ghar par pahunchne par hi cash ya UPI se payment karta hai.
def.mr: Order घरी पोहोचल्यावरच ग्राहक cash किंवा UPI ने पैसे देतो असा payment पर्याय.

def.en: The final steps of an online purchase where the buyer enters address and payment details.
def.hi: Online purchase ke aakhri steps jahan buyer address aur payment details bharta hai.
def.mr: Online खरेदीचे शेवटचे टप्पे, जिथे ग्राहक पत्ता आणि payment तपशील भरतो.

def.en: When shoppers add items to their basket but leave the site without completing the purchase.
def.hi: Jab shoppers basket mein items daalte hain par purchase poori kiye bina site chhod dete hain.
def.mr: ग्राहक basket मध्ये वस्तू टाकतात पण खरेदी पूर्ण न करता साइट सोडून जातात, ती स्थिती.

def.en: Brands selling straight to shoppers through their own website or app, skipping distributors and retailers.
def.hi: Brands jo distributors aur retailers ko chhodkar apni website ya app se seedhe shoppers ko bechte hain.
def.mr: Distributors आणि retailers ना वगळून स्वतःच्या वेबसाइट किंवा app द्वारे थेट ग्राहकांना विक्री करणारे brands.

def.en: Total revenue divided by the number of orders placed over the same period.
def.hi: Ek period ka total revenue, usi period ke orders ki sankhya se divide kiya hua.
def.mr: एका कालावधीतील एकूण revenue भागिले त्याच कालावधीतील orders ची संख्या.

def.en: A unique code identifying each distinct product variant, such as size or color, for inventory tracking.
def.hi: Unique code jo har alag product variant, jaise size ya color, ko inventory tracking ke liye pehchanta hai.
def.mr: Inventory tracking साठी प्रत्येक वेगळ्या product variant (उदा. size किंवा रंग) ला ओळखणारा unique code.

def.en: Encouraging a buyer to purchase a pricier or upgraded version of the item they're considering.
def.hi: Buyer ko us item ka mehenga ya upgraded version kharidne ke liye encourage karna jo woh le raha hai.
def.mr: ग्राहक विचार करत असलेल्या वस्तूची महाग किंवा upgraded आवृत्ती घेण्यास प्रोत्साहित करणे.

def.en: Recommending complementary items, like a case with a phone, to increase the basket size.
def.hi: Complementary items recommend karna, jaise phone ke saath case, taaki basket size badhe.
def.mr: Basket size वाढवण्यासाठी पूरक वस्तू सुचवणे, उदा. phone सोबत case.

def.en: An undelivered order shipped back to the seller, often after COD refusal, costing shipping both ways.
def.hi: Deliver na hua order jo seller ko wapas bheja jata hai, aksar COD refuse hone par, jisme dono taraf ka shipping kharch lagta hai.
def.mr: Deliver न झालेला order विक्रेत्याकडे परत पाठवला जाणे, अनेकदा COD नाकारल्यावर, ज्यात दोन्ही बाजूंचा shipping खर्च लागतो.

def.en: Model where a seller lists products but a supplier ships them directly to customers, so no inventory is held.
def.hi: Model jisme seller products list karta hai par supplier seedha customers ko ship karta hai, isliye inventory nahi rakhni padti.
def.mr: विक्रेता products list करतो पण supplier थेट ग्राहकांना पाठवतो, त्यामुळे inventory ठेवावी लागत नाही असे model.

def.en: Total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers gained in that period.
def.hi: Total sales aur marketing kharch, us period mein mile naye customers ki sankhya se divide kiya hua.
def.mr: एकूण sales आणि marketing खर्च भागिले त्या कालावधीत मिळालेल्या नवीन ग्राहकांची संख्या.

def.en: Total revenue or profit a business expects from one customer over the whole relationship.
def.hi: Poore rishte ke dauraan ek customer se business ko kitna total revenue ya profit milne ki ummeed hai.
def.mr: संपूर्ण नात्यादरम्यान एका ग्राहकाकडून व्यवसायाला अपेक्षित एकूण revenue किंवा नफा.

def.en: Percentage of customers who stop buying or cancel their subscription during a period.
def.hi: Customers ka woh percentage jo ek period mein kharidna band kar dete hain ya subscription cancel kar dete hain.
def.mr: एका कालावधीत खरेदी थांबवणाऱ्या किंवा subscription रद्द करणाऱ्या ग्राहकांची टक्केवारी.

def.en: Loyalty metric from asking how likely customers are to recommend you on 0-10, promoters minus detractors.
def.hi: Loyalty metric jo customers se 0-10 par poochkar banta hai ki woh aapko recommend karenge ya nahi; promoters minus detractors.
def.mr: ग्राहक तुमची शिफारस करण्याची शक्यता 0-10 वर विचारून मिळणारा loyalty metric; promoters वजा detractors.

def.en: Revenue left per order after subtracting variable costs like product cost, shipping and marketing.
def.hi: Har order se product cost, shipping aur marketing jaise variable kharch ghataane ke baad bacha revenue.
def.mr: Product खर्च, shipping आणि marketing सारखे variable खर्च वजा केल्यानंतर प्रत्येक order मधून उरलेले revenue.

def.en: Total sales value of goods sold through a platform before deducting returns, fees or discounts.
def.hi: Platform par beche gaye saamaan ki total sales value, returns, fees ya discounts ghataane se pehle.
def.mr: Returns, fees किंवा discounts वजा करण्यापूर्वी platform वरून विकलेल्या मालाचे एकूण विक्री मूल्य.

def.en: Number of months needed for a customer's gross profit to recover the cost of acquiring them.
def.hi: Kitne mahine lagte hain jab tak customer se mila gross profit use laane ka kharch wapas cover kar de.
def.mr: ग्राहक मिळवण्याचा खर्च त्याच्याकडून मिळणाऱ्या gross profit मधून भरून निघण्यास लागणारे महिने.

def.en: Revenue and costs measured per single order or customer to check whether the business model is profitable.
def.hi: Har ek order ya customer ke hisaab se revenue aur kharch naapna taaki pata chale business model profitable hai ya nahi.
def.mr: Business model फायदेशीर आहे का हे तपासण्यासाठी प्रत्येक order किंवा ग्राहकामागे revenue आणि खर्च मोजणे.

def.en: A small warehouse closed to walk-in shoppers, used only to fulfil quick online deliveries.
def.hi: Chhota warehouse jo walk-in customers ke liye band hota hai aur sirf quick online deliveries ke liye use hota hai.
def.mr: थेट येणाऱ्या ग्राहकांसाठी बंद असलेले, फक्त जलद online deliveries साठी वापरले जाणारे छोटे गोदाम.

def.en: Comparison of a customer's lifetime value with the cost of acquiring them; about 3:1 is often considered healthy.
def.hi: Customer ki lifetime value aur use laane ke kharch ki tulna; lagbhag 3:1 ko aksar healthy maana jata hai.
def.mr: ग्राहकाचे lifetime value आणि त्याला मिळवण्याचा खर्च यांची तुलना; साधारण 3:1 हे अनेकदा निरोगी मानले जाते.

def.en: Stage where a product clearly satisfies strong demand in a well-defined market, driving organic growth and retention.
def.hi: Woh stage jab product ek clear market ki strong demand ko poora karta hai aur organic growth aur retention aata hai.
def.mr: Product एका स्पष्ट market मधील मोठी मागणी पूर्ण करतो आणि organic growth व retention मिळू लागते, तो टप्पा.

def.en: Grouping customers by how recently, how often and how much they buy to target them better.
def.hi: Customers ko is basis par group karna ki unhone kitni haal mein, kitni baar aur kitna kharida, taaki behtar target ho sake.
def.mr: ग्राहकांनी किती अलीकडे, किती वेळा आणि किती खरेदी केली यावर त्यांचे गट करून अधिक चांगले target करणे.

def.en: Percentage of recurring revenue kept from existing customers after upgrades, downgrades and cancellations.
def.hi: Upgrades, downgrades aur cancellations ke baad maujooda customers se bacha recurring revenue ka percentage.
def.mr: Upgrades, downgrades आणि cancellations नंतर सध्याच्या ग्राहकांकडून टिकून राहिलेल्या recurring revenue ची टक्केवारी.

def.en: Days between paying suppliers for inventory and collecting cash from customers who buy it.
def.hi: Inventory ke liye suppliers ko payment karne aur use kharidne wale customers se paisa milne ke beech ke din.
def.mr: Inventory साठी suppliers ना पैसे देणे आणि ती विकत घेणाऱ्या ग्राहकांकडून पैसे मिळणे यांमधील दिवस.

def.en: Average number of new users each existing user brings in; above 1 means self-sustaining growth.
def.hi: Har maujooda user average kitne naye users laata hai; 1 se zyada ka matlab growth khud chalti rehti hai.
def.mr: प्रत्येक सध्याचा user सरासरी किती नवीन users आणतो; 1 पेक्षा जास्त म्हणजे स्वतःहून चालणारी वाढ.

def.en: Software such as Chrome or Firefox used to open and view pages on the internet.
def.hi: Chrome ya Firefox jaisa software jisse internet ke pages khole aur dekhe jaate hain.
def.mr: Internet वरील पाने उघडण्यासाठी व पाहण्यासाठी वापरले जाणारे Chrome किंवा Firefox सारखे software.

def.en: The complete web address used to locate a specific page or file on the internet.
def.hi: Poora web address jisse internet par kisi khaas page ya file ko dhoondha jata hai.
def.mr: Internet वरील विशिष्ट पेज किंवा file शोधण्यासाठी वापरला जाणारा पूर्ण web address.

def.en: Human-readable website name like example.com that is registered and typed to reach a site.
def.hi: Insaan ke padhne layak website naam jaise example.com jo register kiya jata hai aur site tak pahunchne ke liye type hota hai.
def.mr: example.com सारखे माणसांना वाचता येणारे वेबसाइट नाव, जे register करून साइटवर पोहोचण्यासाठी टाइप केले जाते.

def.en: Service that stores a website's files on servers and makes them accessible on the internet.
def.hi: Service jo website ki files servers par store karti hai aur unhe internet par accessible banati hai.
def.mr: वेबसाइटच्या files servers वर साठवून त्या internet वर उपलब्ध करून देणारी सेवा.

def.en: Small data file a website saves in the browser to remember logins, preferences or tracking information.
def.hi: Chhoti data file jo website browser mein save karti hai taaki logins, preferences ya tracking info yaad rahe.
def.mr: Logins, आवडीनिवडी किंवा tracking माहिती लक्षात ठेवण्यासाठी वेबसाइट browser मध्ये साठवते ती छोटी data file.

def.en: Digital file that enables encrypted HTTPS connections and proves a website's identity to browsers.
def.hi: Digital file jo encrypted HTTPS connection enable karti hai aur browsers ko website ki pehchaan saabit karti hai.
def.mr: Encrypted HTTPS connection शक्य करणारी आणि browsers ना वेबसाइटची ओळख सिद्ध करणारी digital file.

def.en: Software like WordPress that lets people create and edit website content without writing code.
def.hi: WordPress jaisa software jisse log bina code likhe website content bana aur edit kar sakte hain.
def.mr: Code न लिहिता वेबसाइटचा content तयार व संपादित करू देणारे WordPress सारखे software.

def.en: Approach where a site's layout automatically adapts to different screen sizes and devices.
def.hi: Approach jisme site ka layout alag-alag screen sizes aur devices ke hisaab se apne aap adjust hota hai.
def.mr: साइटचा layout वेगवेगळ्या screen sizes आणि devices नुसार आपोआप जुळवून घेतो असा दृष्टिकोन.

def.en: A stored copy of data kept close at hand so it loads faster on repeat requests.
def.hi: Data ki stored copy jo paas mein rakhi jaati hai taaki dobara request par jaldi load ho.
def.mr: पुन्हा मागणी झाल्यावर पटकन load व्हावे म्हणून जवळ ठेवलेली data ची साठवलेली प्रत.

def.en: Permanent forwarding of one URL to another, passing visitors and most ranking signals to the new address.
def.hi: Ek URL ko permanently dusre URL par forward karna, jisse visitors aur zyada tar ranking signals naye address par chale jaate hain.
def.mr: एका URL ला कायमस्वरूपी दुसऱ्या URL कडे पाठवणे, ज्यामुळे visitors आणि बहुतेक ranking signals नवीन पत्त्यावर जातात.

def.en: A unique numeric label identifying each device connected to a network such as the internet.
def.hi: Unique numeric label jo internet jaise network se jude har device ko pehchanta hai.
def.mr: Internet सारख्या network ला जोडलेल्या प्रत्येक device ला ओळखणारे unique numeric label.

def.en: The internet's directory that translates human-friendly website names into numeric addresses computers use.
def.hi: Internet ki directory jo insaan ke samajhne layak website names ko computers ke numeric addresses mein badalti hai.
def.mr: माणसांना समजणारी वेबसाइट नावे computers वापरतात त्या numeric पत्त्यांमध्ये रूपांतरित करणारी internet ची directory.

def.en: Globally distributed group of servers that serve website files from the location nearest each visitor.
def.hi: Duniya bhar mein faile servers ka group jo har visitor ko sabse nazdeeki location se website files serve karta hai.
def.mr: प्रत्येक visitor ला सर्वात जवळच्या ठिकाणाहून वेबसाइटच्या files पुरवणारा जगभर पसरलेला servers चा गट.

def.en: Set of rules letting different software programs request data and services from each other.
def.hi: Rules ka set jisse alag-alag software programs ek-dusre se data aur services maang sakte hain.
def.mr: वेगवेगळ्या software programs ना एकमेकांकडून data आणि services मागू देणारा नियमांचा संच.

def.en: Technique that delays loading images or content until they are about to scroll into view.
def.hi: Technique jo images ya content ko tab tak load nahi karti jab tak woh scroll hokar screen par aane wale na hon.
def.mr: Images किंवा content screen वर scroll होऊन दिसणार असतील तेव्हाच load करणारी technique.

def.en: Automatic HTTP message one app sends to another the moment a specific event happens.
def.hi: Automatic HTTP message jo ek app dusre app ko bhejta hai jaise hi koi khaas event hota hai.
def.mr: एखादी विशिष्ट घटना घडताच एक app दुसऱ्या app ला पाठवतो तो automatic HTTP message.

def.en: Generating a page's full HTML on the server before sending it to the browser.
def.hi: Page ka poora HTML browser ko bhejne se pehle server par hi generate karna.
def.mr: Browser ला पाठवण्यापूर्वी पेजचे पूर्ण HTML server वरच तयार करणे.

def.en: Website built with modern features so it can be installed and work offline like a mobile app.
def.hi: Modern features wali website jise install kiya ja sakta hai aur jo mobile app ki tarah offline bhi chal sakti hai.
def.mr: Install करता येणारी आणि mobile app प्रमाणे offline देखील चालू शकणारी modern features असलेली वेबसाइट.

def.en: Content backend that stores content and delivers it through an API, leaving the front-end presentation fully separate.
def.hi: Content backend jo content store karke API se deliver karta hai, aur front-end presentation poori tarah alag rehti hai.
def.mr: Content साठवून API द्वारे पुरवणारा content backend, ज्यात front-end presentation पूर्णपणे वेगळे असते.

def.en: Browser security mechanism controlling whether a web page may request resources from a different domain.
def.hi: Browser security mechanism jo control karta hai ki web page kisi dusre domain se resources request kar sakta hai ya nahi.
def.mr: Web page दुसऱ्या domain कडून resources मागू शकते का हे नियंत्रित करणारी browser security यंत्रणा.

def.en: Delay between a browser requesting a page and receiving the first piece of the server's response.
def.hi: Browser ke page request karne aur server ke response ka pehla hissa milne ke beech ki deri.
def.mr: Browser ने पेज मागणे आणि server च्या response चा पहिला भाग मिळणे यामधील विलंब.

def.en: Security header instructing browsers to connect to a site only over encrypted HTTPS, never plain HTTP.
def.hi: Security header jo browsers ko kehta hai ki site se sirf encrypted HTTPS par hi connect karein, kabhi plain HTTP par nahi.
def.mr: Browsers नी साइटशी फक्त encrypted HTTPS वरच जोडणी करावी, साध्या HTTP वर कधीच नाही, असे सांगणारा security header.

def.en: HTTP header restricting which sources of scripts, styles and other resources a page may load, reducing XSS attacks.
def.hi: HTTP header jo tay karta hai ki page kin sources se scripts, styles aur dusre resources load kar sakta hai, jisse XSS attacks kam hote hain.
def.mr: पेज कोणत्या sources वरून scripts, styles आणि इतर resources load करू शकते हे मर्यादित करून XSS हल्ले कमी करणारा HTTP header.

def.en: Process where client-side JavaScript attaches interactivity to HTML that was already rendered on the server.
def.hi: Process jisme client-side JavaScript server par pehle se render hue HTML mein interactivity jodta hai.
def.mr: Server वर आधीच render झालेल्या HTML ला client-side JavaScript interactivity जोडते ती प्रक्रिया.

def.en: Initial exchange in which a browser and server verify identity and agree on encryption keys before secure data flows.
def.hi: Shuruaati exchange jisme browser aur server pehchaan verify karte hain aur secure data bhejne se pehle encryption keys tay karte hain.
def.mr: सुरक्षित data पाठवण्यापूर्वी browser आणि server ओळख पडताळतात व encryption keys ठरवतात ती सुरुवातीची देवाणघेवाण.

def.en: Computer systems performing tasks that normally need human thinking, like understanding language or recognizing images.
def.hi: Computer systems jo aise kaam karte hain jinke liye aam taur par insaani soch chahiye, jaise bhasha samajhna ya images pehchanna.
def.mr: भाषा समजणे किंवा images ओळखणे यांसारखी सामान्यतः मानवी विचारशक्ती लागणारी कामे करणाऱ्या computer प्रणाली.

def.en: Software that holds text or voice conversations with users and answers their questions automatically.
def.hi: Software jo users ke saath text ya voice mein baat karta hai aur unke sawaalon ke jawab apne aap deta hai.
def.mr: Users शी text किंवा voice मध्ये संवाद साधून त्यांच्या प्रश्नांची उत्तरे आपोआप देणारे software.

def.en: The instruction or question a user gives an AI model in order to get a response.
def.hi: Woh instruction ya sawaal jo user jawab paane ke liye AI model ko deta hai.
def.mr: उत्तर मिळवण्यासाठी user AI model ला देतो ती सूचना किंवा प्रश्न.

def.en: AI models that create new text, images, audio or video based on patterns learned from data.
def.hi: AI models jo data se seekhe patterns ke basis par naya text, images, audio ya video banate hain.
def.mr: Data मधून शिकलेल्या patterns वर आधारित नवीन text, images, audio किंवा video तयार करणारे AI models.

def.en: Approach where computers learn patterns from data to make predictions instead of following hand-written rules.
def.hi: Approach jisme computers haath se likhe rules follow karne ke bajaye data se patterns seekhkar predictions karte hain.
def.mr: हाताने लिहिलेले नियम पाळण्याऐवजी computers data मधून patterns शिकून predictions करतात असा दृष्टिकोन.

def.en: AI model trained on massive amounts of text to understand and generate human-like writing.
def.hi: Bahut bade text data par train kiya gaya AI model jo insaan jaisa likhna samajhta aur generate karta hai.
def.mr: प्रचंड text data वर train केलेले, मानवासारखे लेखन समजणारे आणि तयार करणारे AI model.

def.en: When an AI model confidently produces false or made-up information that sounds plausible.
def.hi: Jab AI model poore confidence se galat ya mangadhant jaankari deta hai jo sach jaisi lagti hai.
def.mr: AI model आत्मविश्वासाने चुकीची किंवा रचलेली, पण खरी वाटणारी माहिती देतो, ती स्थिती.

def.en: Small chunk of text, like a word or part of a word, that language models read, generate and bill by.
def.hi: Text ka chhota tukda, jaise ek word ya word ka hissa, jise language models padhte, generate karte aur jiske hisaab se billing hoti hai.
def.mr: Text चा छोटा तुकडा, उदा. शब्द किंवा शब्दाचा भाग, जो language models वाचतात, तयार करतात आणि ज्यानुसार billing होते.

def.en: Maximum amount of text a model can consider at once, covering both the input and its response.
def.hi: Text ki woh maximum matra jise model ek baar mein dhyan mein le sakta hai, input aur response dono milakar.
def.mr: Model एका वेळी विचारात घेऊ शकतो तेवढा जास्तीत जास्त text, input आणि response दोन्ही मिळून.

def.en: Crafting and refining instructions to get more accurate and useful outputs from AI models.
def.hi: AI models se zyada sahi aur useful output paane ke liye instructions ko design aur refine karna.
def.mr: AI models कडून अधिक अचूक आणि उपयुक्त output मिळवण्यासाठी सूचना तयार करणे आणि सुधारत राहणे.

def.en: Computing system of interconnected layers of nodes, loosely inspired by the brain, that learns from data.
def.hi: Nodes ki aapas mein judi layers wala computing system, jo dimaag se prerit hai aur data se seekhta hai.
def.mr: मेंदूपासून प्रेरित, एकमेकांशी जोडलेल्या nodes च्या layers असलेली आणि data मधून शिकणारी computing प्रणाली.

def.en: Further training a pre-trained model on a smaller specialized dataset to adapt it to a specific task.
def.hi: Pehle se trained model ko chhote specialized dataset par aur train karna taaki woh kisi khaas task ke liye adapt ho jaye.
def.mr: आधीच train केलेल्या model ला विशिष्ट कामासाठी जुळवून घेण्यासाठी लहान, विशेष dataset वर पुन्हा train करणे.

def.en: A list of numbers representing the meaning of text or images, so similar items sit close together.
def.hi: Numbers ki list jo text ya images ka matlab darshati hai, taaki milte-julte items paas-paas rahein.
def.mr: Text किंवा images चा अर्थ दर्शवणारी संख्यांची यादी, ज्यामुळे समान items एकमेकांजवळ राहतात.

def.en: Technique where a model first fetches relevant documents from a knowledge source and uses them to ground its answer.
def.hi: Technique jisme model pehle knowledge source se relevant documents laata hai aur unke basis par apna jawab deta hai.
def.mr: Model आधी knowledge source मधून संबंधित documents आणतो आणि त्यांच्या आधारे उत्तर देतो अशी technique.

def.en: System where a model plans steps and uses tools on its own to complete multi-step goals.
def.hi: System jisme model khud steps plan karta hai aur tools use karke multi-step goals poore karta hai.
def.mr: Model स्वतः पायऱ्या ठरवतो आणि tools वापरून अनेक टप्प्यांची उद्दिष्टे पूर्ण करतो अशी प्रणाली.

def.en: Setting that controls randomness in a model's output; lower is more predictable, higher is more creative.
def.hi: Setting jo model ke output ki randomness control karti hai; kam value zyada predictable, zyada value zyada creative.
def.mr: Model च्या output मधील randomness नियंत्रित करणारी setting; कमी value अधिक अंदाजयोग्य, जास्त value अधिक सर्जनशील.

def.en: Deep learning architecture that uses attention to process sequences in parallel, the basis of modern language models.
def.hi: Deep learning architecture jo attention se sequences ko parallel process karta hai; modern language models ka aadhaar.
def.mr: Attention वापरून sequences समांतरपणे process करणारी deep learning architecture; आधुनिक language models चा पाया.

def.en: When a model memorizes its training examples so closely that it performs poorly on new, unseen data.
def.hi: Jab model training examples ko itna ratt leta hai ki naye, anjaan data par kharab perform karta hai.
def.mr: Model training उदाहरणे इतकी पाठ करतो की नवीन, न पाहिलेल्या data वर खराब कामगिरी करतो, ती स्थिती.

def.en: Training method where people rank model outputs and those preferences are used to reward better responses.
def.hi: Training method jisme log model ke outputs ko rank karte hain aur un preferences se behtar responses ko reward kiya jata hai.
def.mr: लोक model च्या outputs ना क्रम देतात आणि त्या पसंतीचा वापर चांगल्या उत्तरांना reward देण्यासाठी होतो अशी training पद्धत.

def.en: Storage system optimized to save embeddings and quickly find the most similar items to a query.
def.hi: Storage system jo embeddings save karne aur query se sabse milte-julte items jaldi dhoondhne ke liye optimized hai.
def.mr: Embeddings साठवण्यासाठी आणि query शी सर्वाधिक साम्य असलेले items पटकन शोधण्यासाठी optimize केलेली storage प्रणाली.

def.en: Training a smaller model to imitate a larger model's outputs, keeping much of its ability at lower cost.
def.hi: Chhote model ko bade model ke outputs ki nakal karna sikhana, taaki kam kharch mein zyada tar kshamata bani rahe.
def.mr: कमी खर्चात बहुतेक क्षमता टिकवण्यासाठी लहान model ला मोठ्या model च्या outputs ची नक्कल करायला शिकवणे.

def.en: Reducing the numeric precision of a model's weights, such as from 16-bit to 4-bit, to shrink and speed it up.
def.hi: Model ke weights ki numeric precision kam karna, jaise 16-bit se 4-bit, taaki model chhota aur tez ho.
def.mr: Model लहान आणि वेगवान करण्यासाठी त्याच्या weights ची numeric precision कमी करणे, उदा. 16-bit वरून 4-bit.

def.en: Efficient method that trains small add-on weight matrices instead of updating all of a model's parameters.
def.hi: Efficient method jo model ke saare parameters update karne ke bajaye chhote add-on weight matrices train karta hai.
def.mr: Model चे सर्व parameters update करण्याऐवजी छोटे add-on weight matrices train करणारी कार्यक्षम पद्धत.

def.en: Architecture where a router activates only a few specialized sub-networks for each input, saving compute.
def.hi: Architecture jisme router har input ke liye sirf kuch specialized sub-networks ko activate karta hai, jisse compute bachta hai.
def.mr: प्रत्येक input साठी router फक्त काही specialized sub-networks सक्रिय करतो, ज्यामुळे compute वाचतो अशी architecture.

def.en: When further training on new tasks makes a neural network lose abilities it had learned earlier.
def.hi: Jab naye tasks par aur training se neural network pehle seekhi hui kshamataein kho deta hai.
def.mr: नवीन कामांवर पुढील training मुळे neural network आधी शिकलेल्या क्षमता गमावतो, ती स्थिती.
